request.body:
## Result and scope

Refs #50

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/50#issuecomment-6869697742, session `ADB991-claude-20261114-8a6e`
- Unit IDs or other outputs: YM-000026 (C09). `manuscript/existence/heading-history-handoff.tex` (one paragraph) and new note `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C09/author/ADB991-claude-20261114-8a6e.md`.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission. ADB991 did not author #104, the C09 chapters or review #327.

Answers **M1** of hairer's review #327: the "provided ..." clause in "One finite set of insertion types for every grade" listed only (H4)-(H6) and the merger. It now lists every hypothesis of `prop:ex-selected-interpolation` and says which ones this section supplies.

**Supplied here**, on the retained transition and for each grade:
- (a) the heading `T(L)=B∘vowel_L` with B commuting with core deletion and `‖B‖,‖B⁻¹‖ ≤ C_B ≤ C ≤ (C+ηs_f)C_orb ≤ K_f = D_0`;
- (b) the purchase inequalities `eq:ex-interpolation-buy` (with `C ≥ C_B ≥ 1`, `η = L^{-2/5}`) and `t = t_f ≥ 0`;
- (c) the common door and its soundness;
- (d) the component coupons with `eq:history-three-identities` and their prices;
- (e) the common funded wing.

**Inputs, not supplied here:**
- (i) all of (H1)-(H6) for the incoming voice;
- (ii) the three profile hypotheses;
- (iii) the merger and lead-price receipt, from components to basis coupons;
- (iv) the bank and room bounds, pointed to `prop:ex-stored-service-budget`.

This matches the source split: this section corresponds to `YM.MergeProof.Tune`. `Heard`, `Chorus`, `B.Sound A`, nonzero evaluation and `roomCost`/`Bank` are separate hypotheses of `repriseQ`/`compose`. The note has the hypothesis-by-hypothesis table.

**Uncertain:**
- the exact room match `64D_0^2 ≤ c_±`, since the proposition does not name `c_±`;
- the reading of "wings are motion images" as a statement about the reoriented coupons in the proposition's proof.

The C09 `chapter-hashes.json` entry for this chapter is now stale. It is outside this scope and is left for the coordinator or ledger owner after the renewed check.
